# homeracker-community — configurator fork

A fork of [kellerlabs/homeracker-community](https://github.com/kellerlabs/homeracker-community) where
the 3D configurator is being worked on. Everything else — the community models, the core, the
contribution rules — is the upstream project's, and [its README](../README.md) is the one to read for
those.

### **[Launch this fork's configurator](https://infocris.github.io/homeracker-community/configurator/)**

## What this fork adds to the configurator

- **Building** — gravity, two draw modes, bars drawn out of a connector's free sides, supports resized
  by dragging their ends, a working level and a sizeable workspace.
- **Junctions** — a bar goes into a connector end-on or not at all; connectors adapt to what arrives
  and simplify when a bar leaves; a placed connector can be swapped for another.
- **Editing** — parts grouped and handled as one body, a selection turned as one about a pivot that
  stays put, arrow keys that nudge the way they point on screen, duplication with the middle button.
- **Reading the model** — guides that carry a raised part's edges out across the assembly and follow
  the planes it crosses, a part inspector, a hover view of the catalog, height and length readouts.
- **The keyboard and the mouse** — every shortcut listed and rebindable, the gestures written down
  beside a mouse that answers the hand, and a log of what each press was taken for.

## Upstream

Fixes and models belong upstream: [kellerlabs/homeracker-community](https://github.com/kellerlabs/homeracker-community)
for community creations, [kellerlabs/homeracker](https://github.com/kellerlabs/homeracker) for the core.
Upstream's own demo is at <https://kellerlabs.github.io/homeracker-community/configurator/>.

Licensed as upstream: MIT for code, CC BY-SA 4.0 for models.
